subject: Re: Redwood POC — Success criteria & final readout scheduling
summary: Post-discovery follow-up establishing POC success criteria, ownership (SE + AE + RegenHealth execs), proposed evaluation plan and timeline, and scheduling the final readout and decision process (exec review + procurement).
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@regenhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@regenhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood POC next steps — recap & asks

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the call today — great conversation and lots of alignment on what success looks like. Quick recap + a few asks so we can finalize the POC plan: 

- Goal: Validate that Redwood inference can meet RegenHealth latency and throughput targets for real-time chart summarization without impacting PHI controls.
- Proposed POC: 4-week trial with a dedicated endpoint, 100k tokens/day simulated load, and a small representative dataset from Regen (anonymized).
- Success criteria (draft):
  - 95th pct latency < 200ms for single-turn API calls at target concurrency
  - Mean token cost <= agreed threshold (we'll propose batching/quant config)
  - Functional: summaries meet QA baseline (Regen will provide 20 representative prompts + expected output rubric)
  - Security: proof of encryption at rest + audit log access for the trial period

Can you confirm:
1) Decision maker for the final go/no-go (who will join the exec readout)?
2) Procurement contact and any timing constraints on contract review?
3) Whether Regen can provide the 20 prompt/test cases + a 1GB anonymized sample by next Monday (2027-06-07)?

I've attached the call notes. I'll draft a POC plan and share with you and the Regen team + loop in Rachel (SE) and Marcus (commercial) for scoping and credits.

Next step: I'll send a first-pass POC plan by Wednesday (2027-06-02) and propose readout windows the week of June 14/15.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: RegenHealth-call-notes-20270601.pdf (notes stub)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@regenhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@regenhealth.com>; Tom Lee <t.lee@regenhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-02T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood POC next steps — recap & asks

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Decision maker: Priya Singh (CPO) will own the final exec decision; she'll attend the readout.
- Procurement: Tom Lee (procurement) will handle contract/redlines; he prefers to have commercial terms drafted before the readout so procurement can flag anything early.
- We can provide the 20 prompts and a 1GB anonymized sample by 2027-06-07 — I'll have our data engineer drop a link.

Success criteria tweaks:
- Please add: fidelity threshold >= 80% on our rubric for the 20 test prompts.
- Data residency: we need logs and audit artifacts to stay in us-east-1 for the POC.

Timeline: the week of June 14 works for the readout. We'd prefer June 15 morning PT if possible.

Attaching a short doc with our success criteria notes.

Alex
Alex Johnson
VP Product, RegenHealth
alex.johnson@regenhealth.com

Attachment: RegenHealth-success-criteria.docx (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@regenhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@regenhealth.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-06-03T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood POC next steps — POC plan (v1) attached

Alex / team — attaching our first-pass POC plan (v1). High level: 4 weeks with three phases (ingest+integration, load testing/tuning, evaluation + readout). Key owners: Rachel (SE) leads integration & validation, Marcus (sales lead) will handle credits and contract pre-reads, and I'll run the readout logistics.

Highlights in the attached spreadsheet:
- Week 0 (pre-start): dataset handoff + test environment setup (target 2027-06-08 completion)
- Week 1-2: integration + baseline tuning (dedicated endpoint in us-east-1)
- Week 3: load testing & cost tuning (quantization/batching suggestions)
- Week 4: evaluation using 20 prompts + readout prep

Please review, specifically:
- Confirm ownership on Regen side for the 20 prompts (Alex) and data handoff contact (Tom/engineering).
- Rachel — please confirm the SE plan and whether you'll need additional runtime access or sample keys.
- Marcus — can you pre-authorize 60 days of trial credits so we can proceed without procurement blocking the start?

I'll schedule a short kickoff once we confirm the handoff date.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachment: RWD-POC-Plan-RegenHealth-v1.xlsx (stub)

  - Need any special quant/instance types? Estimated additional GPU hours?
- Marcus: can you provision 60 days trial credits and confirm the credit id I can include in the kickoff email?

Let's keep this tight — if we miss week 0 handoff we push the readout week and Priya's availability becomes tricky.

Thanks — Marissa

(On a related note Marc, I'll draft a short commercial note for Tom to speed procurement.)

Subject: Proposed final readout windows + exec review agenda

Alex / Priya / Tom — thanks for confirmation on the dataset timeline. Based on our plan, proposed readout slots (all PT):
- Tue June 15: 10:00-11:00am PT (preferred)
- Tue June 15: 2:00-3:00pm PT (alternate)
- Wed June 16: 9:00-10:00am PT (backup)

Proposed exec readout agenda (30-40 minutes):
- 0-5m: Introductions + POC scope recap (Marissa)
- 5-20m: Demo of representative prompts + performance metrics (Rachel)
- 20-30m: Cost/ops review and security posture for the trial (Marcus + Marissa)
- 30-40m: Q&A and decision framing (Priya & Regen execs)

Decision process: Priya will lead the go/no-go decision at the end of the readout; procurement (Tom) will then start contract redlines. Regen indicated they aim to give a go/no-go within 3 business days post-readout. If that timing holds, commercial can circulate a draft agreement immediately after the readout.

Please reply with the preferred slot and the final list of attendees for the readout. I've attached the readout agenda and will circulate a calendar invite once we lock the time.

Best,
Marissa
